question: What reason did Hezekiah give for asking God to deliver Judah?
options: So all the kingdoms of the earth may know that the LORD alone is God
So Judah could become a great empire
So Hezekiah could take revenge on Assyria
So the people would pay more taxes
explanation: Hezekiah prayed for deliverance so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that the LORD alone is God.
